summary: Completed the assigned read-only review against the recorded source snapshot. One medium finding: startup-failure cleanup closes storage before an already launched seeded agent drains, confirmed with isolated SQLite fault injection. The complete finding, reproduction method/output, coverage and limitations are preserved in review.json.
limitations: This was one bounded, fresh native review with no inherited author transcript. It did not inspect every unrelated service method or constitute a general security review.

Full unit/integration suites, real PostgreSQL fault injection, and a real OIDC sign-in were not executed by this reviewer; their test source and relevant implementation were inspected. Integration verification belongs to the root agent.
The reproduction uses process-local fault injection and an in-memory SQLite database to force the reachable startup timeout interleaving; it did not wait 120 seconds or invoke a model provider.
The report covers the recorded plan.json source snapshot only. Any subsequent fixes require targeted re-verification by the integration owner.
